integrity: Exact symbolic proof steps and a reproducible standard-library finite rational checker; finite tests do not certify universal statements.
scientific_limitations: Local equilibrium stability and an exhaustive nonnegative equilibrium census for an explicitly stated one-parameter four-species family; no global basin or convergence claims. The large-family result requires strict positivity and feasibility inequalities. Independent specialist review remains open.
title: An invasion-determinant threshold for two-resource, two-consumer communities
